lch-1566572.st: Find a Grave: this was St. John's Lutheran Cemetery and "the church is gone"; it sits at Boss Rd and Cemetery Rd, Town of Holton (https://www.findagrave.com/cemetery/ search Christ Lutheran Cemetery, Abbotsford). A second source that a church stood here.
src: Find a Grave (read on the PC thread)

lch-1569384.st: Find a Grave: the cemetery of the German Methodist Church in the Town of Corning, built around 1860 and disbanded before 1930 (https://www.findagrave.com/cemetery/88438/methodist-cemetery). A second source that a church stood here.
src: Find a Grave (read on the PC thread)

lch-2795392.st: Find a Grave: German Trinity Church was founded in 1857 and merged with Saint Peter's in 1875; the Washington County Historical Society marked the old cemetery in 1989 (https://www.findagrave.com/cemetery/2449841/german-trinity-cemetery). A second source: the church site dates 1857-1875.
src: Find a Grave (read on the PC thread)

pd88-m-e-church-louisville.st: Find a Grave (Pleasant Valley Cemetery, 300 m away): the cemetery lies on the south side of the old Louisville Methodist Church, now a private home, and the town of Louisville was given up in 1900. A second source; the building is a house now, so ask first.
src: Find a Grave (read on the PC thread)

pbp77-church-sec-11-t22n-r10w.st: Find a Grave (Saints Peter and Paul Catholic Cemetery, 150 m away): land given by Ferdinand Theisen in 1880 for a church and graveyard; a mission of St. Boniface, Waumandee; the church was torn down in the 1950s. A second source naming the church.
src: Find a Grave (read on the PC thread)

ps97-saint-bridget-church.st: Find a Grave (Saint Bridgets Cemetery, 140 m away): the cemetery is part of the grounds of the old Saint Bridget's Church, and the church is no longer there. A second source.
src: Find a Grave (read on the PC thread)

ppo87-catholic-church-and-cemetery-millt.st: Find a Grave (Long Lake Cemetery, first called Saint Patrick's): the church stood on one side of the cemetery and a school, now gone, on the other; the church was moved away years ago. A second source, and a lost school site beside it.
src: Find a Grave (read on the PC thread)

sc-1837519.st: Find a Grave (Rutchow Cemetery, 240 m away, County Road U between Gilmanton and Prague): this was a growing community called Urban, with a Methodist church, a school and a cheese factory; the congregation later merged with the Montana Methodist church. A second source for the church and the hamlet.
src: Find a Grave (read on the PC thread)

pp77-church-by-h-hamman-sec-18-t26n-r19w.st: Find a Grave (Hamman Cemetery, 44.74287, -92.71932, 560 m from this pin): "where a German Methodist Church was once located", burials 1868-74. A second source; the church likely stood at the cemetery, so check there before this pin's spot.
src: Find a Grave (read on the PC thread)
